layout_and_spacing.philosophy: DAW-inspired Grid density. High structural discipline. Cards are flat and distinct.
layout_and_spacing.scale: Use p-6 or p-8 for main cards. Dashboard widgets should use tight gap-4 but generous internal padding p-6.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid border_subtle for all cards to create the 'Control Room' grid feel. No soft shadows. Use sharp inner glow or 1px strokes.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense data, lists, and tables. Center-align hero text and empty states.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile (z-50) using blurred glassmorphism (bg-[#0d0d0f]/80 backdrop-blur-xl).

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-md). Primary uses #8b5cf6 with a subtle inner shadow or hover glow. NO soft pill shapes.
components.cards: bg-[#141416] border border-white/5 rounded-md. Hover state: bg-[#1a1a1f] border-[#8b5cf6]/30 transition-all duration-300.
components.waveforms: Visual micro-interactions. Create animated CSS bars (or use SVG) in primary or neon pink color when a track is playing.
components.inputs: bg-[#0d0d0f] border-white/10 rounded-sm focus:border-[#8b5cf6] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#8b5cf6] text-white.
components.badges: JetBrains Mono font. For tags (bpm, key, genre): bg-white/5 text-zinc-300. For Escrow/Success: text-[#10b981] bg-[#10b981]/10 border border-[#10b981]/20.

motion.hover: Subtle neon glows on primary buttons: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(139,92,246,0.5)].
motion.transitions: Fast, mechanical transitions (0.15s or 0.2s ease-out). No slow floats.
motion.loading: Use waveform animation loaders or pulsing neon borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use ONLY `.js` and `.jsx` files. DO NOT output `.tsx` or `.ts` files.
CRITICAL: Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, links, form inputs, and interactive elements. Format: kebab-case role-based (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`).
CRITICAL: Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the UI. Use `lucide-react` icons exclusively.

Setup Tailwind for STRICT Dark Mode. The application background must be `#0d0d0f`. Do not build a light mode toggle. Write standard Tailwind classes over this dark base (e.g., bg-[#141416], text-white).

Install Shadcn primitives as needed (button, card, input, badge, tabs, dialog, avatar, slider, scroll-area, dropdown-menu, table) but customize their styles to match this dark, DAW-inspired theme. Remove Vercel-like soft shadows.
For the Beat Marketplace list: Use a dense, tabular grid layout. Each row should contain a mini-waveform, play button, track title, bpm, key, and 'buy' button.
Escrow Tracking: Build a distinct status component for the Order Management page using neon green (#10b981) for 'Funded/Success' states and neon pink (#ec4899) for 'Action Needed'.
AI Career Coach: Use a chat interface with messages overlaid on the abstract_feature_bg (with heavy blur backdrop). The AI messages should have a subtle #8b5cf6 border.
Implement a persistent bottom navigation bar for mobile viewports, hiding the sidebar or top nav as needed.
Waveform Player: When a user clicks play on a beat, show a global sticky player at the bottom of the screen (desktop) or right above the bottom nav (mobile).
Ensure headings use the Unbounded font (imported via Google Fonts) and technical data uses JetBrains Mono.
Integrate the provided image URLs specifically for their mapped sections (Hero, Gigs, Beats). Do NOT use generic placeholder URLs.
